verifiedSurfaceSummary: The current collector enumerates every published archive page and its first-page alias, validates authoritative WordPress API totals, and reads/reconciles every exact native role detail. All publicly rendered criteria fields are retained, including salary/benefits/contact fields omitted by the earlier three-section mapper. WordPress post IDs and generic organization-name schema identifiers are not fabricated formal requisitions. A native hiring organization outside Ammachi Labs is preserved as a held scope observation. Employer/contact addresses and travel wording do not supply job countries. Counts and qualification are runtime-only; broader company scope and cleanup remain unqualified.
